claims: A weak capacitor can cause the motor to hum and fail to start.
It may lead to the motor overheating during operation.
The motor might run at a significantly lower speed than normal.

claims.text: Over many years of use the capacitance of a capacitor can drop, which is known as a weak capacitor and may result in the motor failing to start or to run at full power.
